source: RFC 0010 Appendix E (2026-11-13): synthetic labelled items, temperature 0, i7-10510U no GPU; small n; a measurement, not a ranking. Anything not listed is UNMEASURED: run a trial before relying on it.

rule_check.what: does a short text break any of a few written rules (pass/fail)
rule_check.safeguard: two small seats must agree, else climb: 98% with 13% climbing

field_extraction.what: pull named fields (name, country, price) out of a sentence
field_extraction.safeguard: verify.in_source (each field must appear in the text): measured in real runs, LFM3 1.7B 58/60 with 3 climbing to Haiku, $0.008

intent.what: label a short request with one of five classes
intent.safeguard: two small seats must agree, else climb: 97% with 13% climbing

tone_rubric.what: judge a message against a rubric (warm, plain words, short)
tone_rubric.safeguard: LFM3 alone fails clean messages; qwen3:4b is near the ceiling; both must agree, else climb: 100% with 22% climbing

faithfulness.what: does a summary say only what its source says
faithfulness.safeguard: a free rule (numbers and names of the summary must be in the source) catches every changed fact but no invented one; then the model

code.what: write the code that makes hidden tests pass
code.safeguard: none found: a LFM3 draft then Haiku fix cost more and took 6-12x longer than Haiku alone

transcribe.what: speech to text on a clear synthetic voice
transcribe.safeguard: tiny is enough on clean audio, 2-3 s for 25 s

local.note: 5 s for 24 s of audio; intelligible (transcribed back at 3-5% word error)

speak.safeguard: transcribe it back and compare with the script

not_for_small_models: anything no cheap check can tell was wrong
